title: tyrus-lint Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the tyrus linter.

api-no-verb-in-path.description: Warns when an HTTP route path uses action verbs instead of resource-oriented paths.

api-prefer-resource-nouns.description: Warns when HTTP route paths do not look like resource nouns.

controller-must-send-response.description: Requires HTTP controllers to complete every success path with `reply.status(...).send(...)`.

controller-no-db-access.description: Forbids direct database access from HTTP controllers.

controller-no-try-catch.description: Warns when HTTP controllers catch expected errors instead of letting services map them.

db-explicit-select-columns.description: Encourages explicit SELECT projections and can expand them from the local result interface.

db-no-extra-select-columns.description: Warns when a SQL SELECT projects columns that the result interface does not use.

exhaustive-match.description: Requires match over a closed type (enum, union, literal union, boolean) to cover every case. Enforced by the compiler (E0004).

export-protect-no-effect.description: Warns when `export protect` sits in the source root, where its folder scope already covers the whole project and narrows nothing.

http-no-raw-status-code.description: Warns when HTTP responses use raw numeric status codes instead of `HttpStatus` members.

no-duplicate-case.description: Detects duplicate cases in switch or match.

no-duplicate-imports.description: Detects multiple import statements from the same module.

no-empty-block.description: Detects empty blocks without an explanatory comment.

no-empty-catch.description: Detects an empty catch block without an explanatory comment.

no-floating-enum.description: Forbids f64/f128 values in an enum. Enforced by the compiler (E0701).

no-force-unwrap.description: Forbids forced unwrap (expr!) on optional values. Enforced by the compiler (E0716).

no-heterogeneous-enum.description: Forbids mixing value types within a primitive enum. Enforced by the compiler (E0702).

no-implicit-enum-primitive-cast.description: Forbids implicit conversion of an enum to its underlying primitive. Enforced by the compiler (E0308).

no-implicit-heavy-move.description: Warns when a large or non-Copy value is moved in a potentially surprising way.

no-layer-skip.description: Warns when API code skips the route-controller-service-repository layering.

no-null-literal.description: Forbids the `null` keyword. Nullable values use `T?`; absence is produced by optional fields, optional parameters, and external boundaries.

no-shadow.description: Detects a binding that shadows another binding from an enclosing scope.

no-string-concat-in-loop.description: Detects repeated string concatenation inside a loop.

no-uninitialized-variable.description: Surfaces deferred `let x: T;` bindings that are used before assignment or never assigned (compiler diagnostics E0381/E0382).

no-unnecessary-await.description: Reserved until async returns can adopt a Promise without changing the declared payload type. Currently disabled.

no-unnecessary-clone.description: Detects a clone where the value could be borrowed instead.

no-upward-imports.description: Forbids imports from lower API layers back into higher layers.

no-unreachable-code.description: Detects code that can never execute because it follows return, break, continue, or throw.

no-unsafe-finally.description: Detects return, throw, break, or continue inside a finally block, which can override the try/catch result.

no-useless-null-check.description: Detects a null check on a value that can never be null.

no-unused-functions.description: Detects non-exported functions that are never called.

no-unused-imports.description: Detects imported names that are never used.

no-unused-vars.description: Detects declared variables that are never used.

prefer-borrow.description: Suggests passing a reference when a function does not need ownership.

prefer-const.description: Suggests const when a let binding is never reassigned.

prefer-nullish-coalescing.description: Suggests ?? instead of a ternary that falls back on null.

repository-no-http-error.description: Warns when repositories throw HTTP-layer errors instead of database/domain errors.

repository-only-db-access.description: Restricts direct database access to repository modules.

route-no-business-logic.description: Warns when route modules contain business logic instead of declarations.

service-no-reply.description: Forbids services from depending on `HttpReply` or sending HTTP responses directly.

use-caught-error.description: Detects a caught error that is never used.
